title: Budgets and labels
summary: Budgets help monitor spend and send notifications. Labels help group costs by project purpose. Neither is a reason to skip cost review.
introduction: Budgets help monitor spend and send notifications. Labels help group costs by project purpose. Neither is a reason to skip cost review. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: Budgets help monitor spend and send notifications. Labels help group costs by project purpose. Neither is a reason to skip cost review.

blocks.title: Budgets and labels

blocks.text: The label helps organise the resources; the alert threshold is 3 units. These are invented numbers.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Calculate an 80 percent threshold for 10 units.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Budget alerts do not automatically stop all Google Cloud spending.
For more detail later, use this [Google Cloud Platform further reading](https://cloud.google.com/docs/overview).
